# free5gc Helm chart

This is a Helm chart for deploying the [free5GC](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc) on Kubernetes. It can be used to deploy the following Helm charts:
 - [free5gc-amf](./charts/free5gc-amf)
 - [free5gc-ausf](./charts/free5gc-ausf)
 - [free5gc-n3iwf](./charts/free5gc-n3iwf)
 - [free5gc-nrf](./charts/free5gc-nrf)
 - [free5gc-nssf](./charts/free5gc-nssf)
 - [free5gc-pcf](./charts/free5gc-pcf)
 - [free5gc-smf](./charts/free5gc-smf)
 - [free5gc-udm](./charts/free5gc-udm)
 - [free5gc-udr](./charts/free5gc-udr)
 - [free5gc-upf](./charts/free5gc-upf)
 - [free5gc-webui](./charts/free5gc-webui)

## Pod seccomp profile

The network function charts set `podSecurityContext.seccompProfile.type` to
`RuntimeDefault` by default. This applies to their init containers and main
containers. Each chart can override the value through its `podSecurityContext`;
the UPF chart has separate values for `upf`, `iupf1`, `psaupf1`, and `psaupf2`.

## Prerequisites
 - A Kubernetes cluster ready to use with all worker nodes using kernel `5.0.0-23-generic` and they should contain gtp5g kernel module.
 - The AMF NGAP service relies on SCTP which is supported by default in Kubernetes from version [1.20](https://kubernetes.io/docs/setup/release/notes/#feature) onwards. If you are using an older version of Kubernetes please refer to this [link](https://v1-19.docs.kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#sctp) to enbale SCTP support.
 - A Persistent Volume Provisioner (optional).
 - [Multus-CNI](https://github.com/intel/multus-cni).
 - [Helm3](https://helm.sh/docs/intro/install/).
 - [Kubectl](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/tools/install-kubectl/) (optional).
 - A physical network interface on each Kubernetes node named `eth0`.
 - A physical network interface on each Kubernetes node named `eth1` to connect the UPF to the Data Network.
**Note:** If the names of network interfaces on your Kubernetes nodes are different from `eth0` and `eth1`, see [Networks configuration](#networks-configuration).

## Quickstart guide

### Verify the kernel version on worker nodes
```console
uname -r
```
It should be `5.0.0-23-generic`.

### Install the gtp5g kernel module on worker nodes
Please follow [free5GC's wiki](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc/wiki/Installation#c-install-user-plane-function-upf).


### Create a Persistent Volume
If you don't have a Persistent Volume provisioner, you can use the following commands to create a namespace for the project and a [Persistent Volume](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/) within this namespace that will be consumed by MongoDB by adapting it to your implementation (you have to replace `worker1` by the name of the node and `/home/vagrant/kubedata` by the right directory on this node in which you want to persist the MongoDB data).
```console
kubectl create ns <namespace>
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: example-local-pv9
  labels:
    project: free5gc
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 8Gi
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  local:
    path: /home/vagrant/kubedata
  nodeAffinity:
    required:
      nodeSelectorTerms:
      - matchExpressions:
        - key: kubernetes.io/hostname
          operator: In
          values:
          - worker1
EOF
```
**NOTE:** you must create the folder on the right node before creating the Peristent Volume.

### Install free5gc
```console
helm -n <namespace> install <release-name> ./free5gc/
```

### Check the state of the created pod
```console
kubectl -n <namespace> get pods -l "project=free5gc"
```

### Access the WebUI

#### Option 1: ClusterIP (default)

The WebUI service uses `ClusterIP` by default. Install the free5gc chart without overriding the service type:

```console
helm -n <namespace> install <release-name> ./free5gc/
```

If an existing release uses `NodePort`, switch it back to `ClusterIP` while retaining its other values:

```console
helm -n <namespace> upgrade <release-name> ./free5gc/ \
  --reuse-values \
  --set free5gc-webui.webui.service.type=ClusterIP
```

To access the WebUI locally, start port-forwarding in a separate terminal:

```console
kubectl -n <namespace> port-forward svc/webui-service 5000:5000
```

Open http://127.0.0.1:5000 while port-forward is running.

#### Option 2: NodePort

To access the WebUI through a Kubernetes node's IP address, enable `NodePort` when installing the free5gc chart:

```console
helm -n <namespace> install <release-name> ./free5gc/ \
  --set free5gc-webui.webui.service.type=NodePort
```

For an existing release, upgrade it while retaining its current values:

```console
helm -n <namespace> upgrade <release-name> ./free5gc/ \
  --reuse-values \
  --set free5gc-webui.webui.service.type=NodePort
```

Open `http://<node-ip>:30500`, replacing `<node-ip>` with a reachable IP address of one of your Kubernetes nodes. The default node port is `30500`; make sure it is reachable from your browser. Port-forwarding is not required for this option.

### Uninstall free5gc
```console
helm -n <namespace> delete <release-name>
```
Or...
```console
helm -n <namespace> uninstall <release-name>
```

## Configuration

### Service exposure with ClusterIP

The WebUI and AMF N2 (NGAP) services use `ClusterIP` by default.

Install the free5gc chart without overriding the service types:

```console
helm -n <namespace> install <release-name> ./free5gc/
```

If an existing release uses `NodePort`, switch both services back to `ClusterIP` while retaining its other values:

```console
helm -n <namespace> upgrade <release-name> ./free5gc/ \
  --reuse-values \
  --set free5gc-webui.webui.service.type=ClusterIP \
  --set global.amf.service.ngap.type=ClusterIP
```

### Service exposure with NodePort

To expose either service through a node port, add the corresponding option to your Helm install or upgrade command for the free5gc chart:

- WebUI: `--set free5gc-webui.webui.service.type=NodePort`
  Then access `http://<node-ip>:30500`.
- AMF N2: `--set global.amf.service.ngap.type=NodePort`
  Then configure your external gNB to connect to `<node-ip>:31412` using SCTP.

The configured node ports default to `30500` for WebUI and `31412` for AMF N2. They are rendered only for `NodePort` or `LoadBalancer` services when the configured value is nonzero. Set the corresponding value to `0` to let Kubernetes allocate the node port automatically:

- WebUI: `free5gc-webui.webui.service.nodePort`
- AMF N2: `global.amf.service.ngap.nodeport`

For an existing `NodePort` service, Kubernetes may retain its allocated node port when the configured value is set to `0`; this does not force a new allocation. Use `kubectl -n <namespace> get svc` to check the actual assigned ports.

### Connection for UERANSIM (Without Multus CNI)

If Multus CNI is not enabled and you need to use UERANSIM for connectivity:

- **Modify `charts/ueransim/values.yaml`:**
    - Update `global.free5gcReleaseName` to match your `helm install` specific **release name**.

### Enable Multus CNI

- Currently, free5gc-helm does not use Multus CNI by default.
- To enable it, follow these steps:
    - **`charts/free5gc/values.yaml`**:
        - Set `global.amf.multus.enabled`, `global.smf.multus.enabled`, and `global.upf.multus.enabled` to `true`.
        - Set `global.amf.service.ngap.enabled` to `false`.
    - **`charts/ueransim/values.yaml`**:
        - Set `global.gnb.multus.enabled` to `true`.

### Multus CNI Configuration

When Multus CNI is enabled, update **`charts/free5gc/values.yaml`** with the following settings:

**1. Network Interface Setup**

#
# Software Name : towards5gs-helm
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2021 Orange
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# This software is distributed under the Apache License 2.0,
# the text of which is available at todo
# or see the "LICENSE" file for more details.
#
# Author: Abderaouf KHICHANE, Ilhem FAJJARI, Ayoub BOUSSELMI
# Software description: An open-source project providing Helm charts to deploy 5G components (Core + RAN) on top of Kubernetes
#
global:
  amf:
    service:
      ngap:
        enabled: true
        name: amf-n2
        port: 38412
        nodeport: 31412
        protocol: SCTP
        type: NodePort
  n2network:
    enabled: false

{{- end }}

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "free5gc-upf.fullname" $ }}-{{ .name }}-configmap
  labels:
    app: {{ $.Values.global.projectName }}
data:
  upfcfg.yaml: |
    version: 1.0.3
    description: UPF initial local configuration

    # The listen IP and nodeID of the N4 interface on this UPF (Can't set to 0.0.0.0)
    pfcp:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
      addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n4if.ipAddress }} # IP addr for listening
      nodeID: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n4if.ipAddress }} # External IP or FQDN can be reached
{{- else }}
      addr: POD_IP_ADDR # IP addr for listening - replaced at runtime
      nodeID: POD_IP_ADDR # External IP or FQDN can be reached - replaced at runtime
{{- end }}
      retransTimeout: 1s # retransmission timeout
      maxRetrans: 3 # the max number of retransmission

    gtpu:
      forwarder: gtp5g
      # The IP list of the N3/N9 interfaces on this UPF
      # If there are multiple connection, set addr to 0.0.0.0 or list all the addresses
      ifList:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
        - addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n3if.ipAddress }}
          type: N3
{{- else }}
        - addr: POD_IP_ADDR
          type: N3
{{- end }}
          # name: upf.5gc.nctu.me
          # ifname: gtpif

    {{- toYaml .configuration | nindent 4 }}

  wrapper.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    set -e

{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
    # Multus mode: Static IPs and dedicated interfaces are configured
    echo "[wrapper] Multus mode enabled - using dedicated interfaces"
    
    # Setup networking rules
    iptables -A FORWARD -j ACCEPT
    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} -o n6 -j MASQUERADE
    echo "1200 n6if" >> /etc/iproute2/rt_tables
    ip rule add from {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} table n6if
    ip route add default via {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.n6network.gatewayIP }} dev n6 table n6if

    {{- if $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}

    exec /free5gc/upf -c {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml
{{- else }}
    # Dynamic Pod IP mode: Single interface (eth0)
    # Get Pod IP dynamically
    POD_IP=$(hostname -i | awk '{print $1}')
    echo "[wrapper] UPF Pod IP detected: $POD_IP"

    # Copy config to writable location
    cp {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    # Replace POD_IP_ADDR placeholder with actual Pod IP
    sed -i "s/POD_IP_ADDR/$POD_IP/g" /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    echo "[wrapper] UPF PFCP config:"
    cat /tmp/upfcfg.yaml | grep -A3 "pfcp:"

    # Wait for upfgtp interface to be created by gtp5g module
    echo "[wrapper] Waiting for upfgtp interface..."
    for i in $(seq 1 30); do
      if ip link show upfgtp > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[wrapper] upfgtp interface is ready"
        break
      fi
      sleep 1
    done

    {{- if $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}

    echo "[wrapper] Starting UPF with dynamic config"
    exec /free5gc/upf -c /tmp/upfcfg.yaml
{{- end }}

{{- end }}
{{- end }}

  labels:

data:
  upfcfg.yaml: |
    version: 1.0.3
    description: UPF initial local configuration

    # The listen IP and nodeID of the N4 interface on this UPF (Can't set to 0.0.0.0)
    pfcp:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
      addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n4if.ipAddress }} # IP addr for listening
      nodeID: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n4if.ipAddress }} # External IP or FQDN can be reached
{{- else }}
      addr: POD_IP_ADDR # IP addr for listening - replaced at runtime
      nodeID: POD_IP_ADDR # External IP or FQDN can be reached - replaced at runtime
{{- end }}
      retransTimeout: 1s # retransmission timeout
      maxRetrans: 3 # the max number of retransmission

    gtpu:
      forwarder: gtp5g
      # The IP list of the N3/N9 interfaces on this UPF
      # If there are multiple connection, set addr to 0.0.0.0 or list all the addresses
      ifList:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
        - addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n3if.ipAddress }}
          type: N3
{{- else }}
        - addr: POD_IP_ADDR
          type: N3
{{- end }}
          # name: upf.5gc.nctu.me
          # ifname: gtpif

    {{- toYaml .configuration | nindent 4 }}

  wrapper.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    set -e

{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
    # Multus mode: Static IPs and dedicated interfaces are configured
    echo "[wrapper] Multus mode enabled - using dedicated interfaces"
    
    # Setup networking rules
    iptables -A FORWARD -j ACCEPT
    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} -o n6 -j MASQUERADE
    echo "1200 n6if" >> /etc/iproute2/rt_tables
    ip rule add from {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} table n6if
    ip route add default via {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.n6network.gatewayIP }} dev n6 table n6if

    {{- if $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}

    exec /free5gc/upf -c {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml
{{- else }}
    # Dynamic Pod IP mode: Single interface (eth0)
    # Get Pod IP dynamically
    POD_IP=$(hostname -i | awk '{print $1}')
    echo "[wrapper] UPF Pod IP detected: $POD_IP"

    # Copy config to writable location
    cp {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    # Replace POD_IP_ADDR placeholder with actual Pod IP
    sed -i "s/POD_IP_ADDR/$POD_IP/g" /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    echo "[wrapper] UPF PFCP config:"
    cat /tmp/upfcfg.yaml | grep -A3 "pfcp:"

    # Wait for upfgtp interface to be created by gtp5g module
    echo "[wrapper] Waiting for upfgtp interface..."
    for i in $(seq 1 30); do
      if ip link show upfgtp > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[wrapper] upfgtp interface is ready"
        break
      fi
      sleep 1
    done

    {{- if $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}

    echo "[wrapper] Starting UPF with dynamic config"
    exec /free5gc/upf -c /tmp/upfcfg.yaml
{{- end }}

{{- end }}
{{- end }}

    gtpIp: GNB_POD_IP    # gNB's local IP address for N3 Interface

    amfConfigs:
      - address: {{ $.Values.global.free5gcReleaseName }}-{{ .amf.n2if.serviceName }}
        port: {{ .amf.n2if.port }}
{{- end }}

    #!/bin/sh
    set -e
    
{{- if $.Values.global.gnb.multus.enabled }}
    # Multus mode: Static IPs are configured, run gNB directly
    echo "[gNB wrapper] Multus mode enabled - using static IP configuration"
    exec ./nr-gnb -c /ueransim/config/gnb-config.yaml
{{- else }}
    # Dynamic Pod IP mode
    # Get Pod IP dynamically
    POD_IP=$(hostname -i | awk '{print $1}')
    echo "[gNB wrapper] Pod IP detected: $POD_IP"
    
    # Copy config to writable location
    cp /ueransim/config/gnb-config.yaml /tmp/gnb-config.yaml
    
    # Replace POD_IP placeholder
    sed -i "s/GNB_POD_IP/$POD_IP/g" /tmp/gnb-config.yaml
    
    echo "[gNB wrapper] Configuration prepared:"
    cat /tmp/gnb-config.yaml | grep -E "linkIp|ngapIp|gtpIp"
    
    # Execute gNB
    exec ./nr-gnb -c /tmp/gnb-config.yaml

## (1) 部署的元件與設定

**Helm chart**：我 clone 了 `free5gc/free5gc-helm`，checkout 到 `07139fcc6f7579928a0722e274bdc876a4a4e240`（`git rev-parse HEAD` 已確認）。我直接用 repo 內的本地 chart 安裝，所有 NF 映像都是 `v4.3.0`。

**Release（namespace `free5gc`）**
- `free5gc`：包含 AMF、SMF、UPF、NRF、NSSF、PCF、UDM、UDR、AUSF、CHF、BSF、NEF、SCP、WebUI 和 MongoDB。
- `ueransim`：包含 1 個 gNB 和 1 個 UE，使用 UERANSIM v3.2.7。

**設定檔**在 `/home/vagrant/work/values/`：`free5gc-values.yaml`、`ueransim-values.yaml`、`subscriber.json`。

- **單一 UPF**：`global.userPlaneArchitecture: single`。chart 預設是 `ulcl`，會多出 3 個 UPF。
- **Multus**：不使用，也沒裝。所有介面都走 pod 的 eth0，gNB 透過 AMF 的 SCTP ClusterIP Service 連到 AMF。
- **PLMN 與 slice**：PLMN 為 208/93。AMF 與 NSSF 的 slice 清單我都從兩個以上刪到只剩 SST 1 / SD 010203，SMF 與 UE 也只用這一個 slice。
- **DNN**：只有 `internet`。UE 位址池是 10.60.0.0/16。
- **UE**：SUPI 為 `imsi-208930000000001`。UE 設定的 `default-nssai` 原本是 `sd: 1`，我改成 `0x010203`，和其他設定一致。
- **訂閱資料**：用 WebUI API（admin/free5gc，只用於叢集內）建立。內容是 5G-AKA、K=`8baf…6862`、OPc=`8e27…605d`，slice 和 DNN 同上。

**我對 chart 預設做了兩處修改**
1. **UPF 的 NAT 介面**：預設用 `natIfCIDR: 192.168.0.0/16`（針對 Calico），不適用於 K3s 的 flannel（10.42.0.0/16）。我改成 `natifname: eth0`。
2. **MongoDB 儲存**：chart 內建的 PV 綁定在主機名 `free5gc` 和 `microk8s-hostpath` 這個 storageClass，在這台機器上不存在。我把 `mongodb.extraDeploy` 設成 `[]`，並改用 K3s 內建的 `local-path`。
   - 第一次安裝因此卡在 MongoDB Pending，我解除安裝後重裝。
   - 我自己改 AMF 設定時漏掉了 timer 等欄位，AMF 一度 CrashLoop。後來改成完整複製原設定、只刪掉多餘的 slice，並 `helm upgrade` 修好。

## (2) 驗證方式

- **Pod 狀態**：17 個 pod 全部 `1/1 Running`，重啟次數都是 0。
- **核心網內部**：
  - UPF 日誌顯示收到 SMF 的 PFCP Association Setup，SMF 日誌也顯示 association 成功。
  - SMF 已向 NRF 註冊，註冊內容只有 1 個 slice `1-010203`。
- **gNB 與 AMF**：gNB 日誌顯示 SCTP 連線建立、`NG Setup procedure is successful`，之後也出現 `PDU session resource(s) setup`。
- **UE**：
  - `Initial Registration is successful`，狀態進入 `MM-REGISTERED/NORMAL-SERVICE`。
  - `PDU Session establishment is successful PSI[1]`，並顯示 `TUN interface[uesimtun0, 10.60.0.1] is up`。
  - 在 UE pod 內確認 `uesimtun0` 的位址是 10.60.0.1/16。
- **對外連線**：
  - `ping -I uesimtun0 8.8.8.8` 傳 4 個、收 4 個，0% loss，延遲約 8–13 ms。
  - 同樣方式 ping 1.1.1.1 成功（2/2），ping google.com 也成功（3/3），表示 DNS 解析也走這條 tunnel。
- **確認流量走 GTP-U 路徑**：UE 的 `uesimtun0` 收到 7 個 / 588 bytes 的回應封包，和 UPF 的 `upfgtp` 介面送出的 7 個 / 588 bytes 吻合，等於那 7 個 ping。UPF 內也有 `-s 10.60.0.0/16 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE` 的 NAT 規則。

**限制**：`upfgtp` 的 TX errors 計數是 6，我判斷是 UE 的 IPv6 link-local 封包，因為 PDU session 只配 IPv4，這些封包沒有對應的轉送規則。IPv4 流量不受影響，但我沒有進一步查證。UE 映像裡沒有 `curl`、`wget`、`traceroute`，所以沒做 HTTP 測試，只做了 ICMP 和 DNS。

SMF 在啟動時解析一次 UPF 的 pod IP。如果 UPF pod 重啟換了 IP，SMF 需要跟著重啟，我沒有處理這點。
